sloka: आदित्यपथमाश्रित्य जगाम स गतक्लमः।हनुमांस्त्वरितो वीरः पितृतुल्यपराक्रमः ।। ६.७४.५४ ।।
transliteration: ādityapathamāśritya jagāma sa gataklamaḥ।hanumāṁstvarito vīraḥ pitṛtulyaparākramaḥ ।। 6.74.54 ।।

translations.english: Maruthi, the tiger among monkeys went like the wind possessing great speed filling sound in all directions.
